title: Lake Louise, Moraine Lake ,Emerald Lake & Banff(optional:Gondola)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
The remaining hours are allotted for the travel time.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Embark on a full-day tour to witness the beauty of Canadian Rockies. Start your day with a pick-up from Calgary, Canmore, or Banff. Pass by the Three Sisters and Castle Mountain on your way to Emerald Lake and Natural Bridge. Next, Next, explore the Lake Louise and Moraine Lake (visit Moraine Lake from Jun to Oct 13th, visit Johnston Canyon in winter). In winter, experience an ice walk in the world-famous Johnston Canyon. Pass by the Vermillion Lakes and stop in Banff Town for 1 hour or choose to Banff Gondola (ticket not included). After a day of exploring, relax on the drive back to your starting point.

•A small group allows your guide to give you more interaction and details to make your experience more comfortable
•Hassle-free pickup and drop-off services available from Calgary, Canmore, and Banff
•Witness the world-famous Lake Louise and Moraine Lake/Johnston Canyon 
•See the stunning Emerald Lake and Natural Bridge, and have fun at Banff town or Banff Gondola
